statements.text: The F-35 system is everything from the person who checks the air pressure and the tires and the maintenance crew to the pilot, to the interaction between different sensors and nodes, the combination of machine learning or artificial intelligence being able to help us predict things.
statements.venue: Punchbowl News interview on defense aviation

statements.text: Big data and artificial intelligence, cloud storage and computing, the Internet of Things and data analytics, telemedicine, and other modern tools simply cannot be replicated without broadband access to the Internet.
statements.venue: House Agriculture subcommittee hearing opening remarks (press release)

statements.text: There are going to have to be some parameters on what happens with water usage and with power and other things with regard to any of the data centers that are going to be built in the future. [...] Closed-loop systems don't use nearly as much water as the old systems do. We need to make sure that we're talking about what kind of cooling systems they have.

[Computing] is a big part of everything we do… It's a big part of national security. It's important that they actually be geographically in the United States of America. [...] It's hard enough to protect people's information when it is physically inside the United States of America. But if those centers are built outside of the United States of America, then everybody's personal information will be all over the world.
statements.venue: WALB interview on data centers and national security

statements.text: We need to make sure that the companies who build the data centers are paying their own cost of energy… and that there's no increased cost of power for the citizens of the communities that they come into… protect their water supply… protect their power supply and their power bill.
statements.venue: WALB interview on data centers and energy costs
